name: course-calibration-v2-source-aware
purpose: Calibrate each course environment from authoritative geometry when available, otherwise from an independent validation-only fixed-pool pilot.
review_gate: Every validation-pilot job uses the shared fixed candidate pool, identity input reward scales, nominal dynamics, immutable validation preferences, and independent v2 seeds.

Every environment-reference-front artifact matches the predeclared package version, environment-config hash, return gamma, protocol hash, and plan hash and is identical across the declared determinism seeds.
No source artifact uses the final test split, final-test preferences, or a non-nominal dynamics shift.
Every proposed reference point is strictly dominated by every scaled point from its declared calibration source.
The versioned proposal is reviewed before a separate protocol edit freezes values; post-freeze diagnostics cannot revise them.
